keys.heading: API key
keys.intro: Use an API key to call the public API at POST /api/v1/charts. See the API docs.
keys.loadFailed: Couldn’t load your API keys. Refresh to try again.
keys.createFailed: Creating the key failed. Please try again later.
keys.revokeFailed: Revoking the key failed. Please try again later.
keys.newKey: This is your new API key, and it is shown only this once. Copy it now and keep it safe: it can’t be shown again.
keys.confirmText: Revoking this key stops it working at once, and it can’t be undone.
